title: psoralea sabulosa
intro: Psoralea sabulosa, commonly known as sand or sand psoralea, is a type of flowering plant in the legume family. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and other inflammatory diseases. The therapeutic actions of Psoralea sabulosa include its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include coumarins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
